points.title: 早年成长
points.description: 曹操出生于沛国谯县（今安徽亳州），出身官宦世家，祖父曹腾是宦官，父亲曹嵩是太尉。少年时期，曹操聪明好学，尤喜兵法，博览群书。他性格豪放不羁，喜欢游猎，不拘小节。20岁时被举为孝廉，任洛阳北部尉，执法严明，不畏权贵，曾用五色棒打死违禁的宦官蹇硕的叔父，初显其刚毅果断的性格。这段时期奠定了他日后政治军事生涯的基础，也培养了他对权贵的警惕和对法制的重视。
points.descriptionEn: Cao Cao was born in Qiao County (modern-day Bozhou, Anhui) into an official family. His grandfather Cao Teng was a eunuch, and his father Cao Song served as Grand Marshal. In his youth, Cao Cao was intelligent and studious, particularly fond of military strategy. He was known for his unrestrained personality and enjoyed hunting and outdoor activities. At age 20, he was recommended as a Xiaolian and appointed as Commandant of the Northern Part of Luoyang, where he enforced the law strictly, even punishing relatives of powerful eunuchs. This period laid the foundation for his future political and military career, while also cultivating his vigilance toward the powerful and his emphasis on legal order.

points.title: 黄巾起义
points.description: 184年，黄巾起义爆发，曹操被任命为济南相，后转为东郡太守。在镇压黄巾起义的过程中，曹操展现出了卓越的军事才能和领导能力。他招募了大量人才，包括荀彧、程昱等谋士，形成了自己的核心团队。同时，他注重军纪，提出'宁可我负天下人，休教天下人负我'的处世哲学。在洛阳期间，曹操目睹了汉室的衰败和宦官专权的乱象，对东汉王朝的腐败有了深刻认识，这促使他日后'挟天子以令诸侯'的政治策略的形成。这一时期，曹操的军事才能和政治理念初步形成，为他日后统一北方奠定了基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 184, when the Yellow Turban Rebellion broke out, Cao Cao was appointed as Chancellor of Jinan and later as Administrator of Dongjun Commandery. While suppressing the rebellion, Cao Cao demonstrated outstanding military talent and leadership abilities. He recruited numerous talented individuals, including strategists like Xun Yu and Cheng Yu, forming his core team. During this time in Luoyang, Cao Cao witnessed the decline of the Han court and the chaos of eunuch dominance, gaining profound insight into the corruption of the Eastern Han Dynasty. This experience influenced his later political strategy of 'controlling the emperor to command the nobles.' This period marked the initial formation of Cao Cao's military skills and political philosophy, laying the foundation for his future unification of northern China.

points.title: 挟天子令诸侯
points.description: 196年，曹操迎汉献帝刘协到许昌（今河南许昌），'挟天子以令诸侯'，获得了政治上的巨大优势。在此期间，曹操实行屯田制，解决了军粮问题；推行'唯才是举'的用人政策，打破了传统的门第观念；颁布'租调制'，减轻农民负担。同时，他继续征战四方，先后击败了吕布、袁术、袁绍等割据势力，基本统一了中国北方。208年，曹操进位为丞相，权力达到顶峰。在许昌的12年，是曹操政治生涯的黄金时期，他不仅巩固了自己的权力基础，还实施了一系列有利于社会经济发展的政策，为魏国的建立奠定了坚实基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 196, Cao Cao welcomed Emperor Xian of Han (Liu Xie) to Xuchang (modern-day Xuchang, Henan), gaining tremendous political advantage by 'controlling the emperor to command the nobles.' During this period, Cao Cao implemented the Tuntian system (military agricultural colonies) to solve military food supply issues; promoted the policy of 'employing based on talent only,' breaking traditional class barriers; and issued the 'Zhu Tiao' system to reduce peasants' burdens. Meanwhile, he continued military campaigns, defeating warlords such as Lü Bu, Yuan Shu, and Yuan Shao, essentially unifying northern China. By 208, Cao Cao was promoted to Chancellor, reaching the peak of his power. The 12 years in Xuchang represented the golden period of Cao Cao's political career, during which he not only consolidated his power base but also implemented policies beneficial to social and economic development, laying a solid foundation for the establishment of the Wei kingdom.

points.title: 赤壁之战
points.description: 208年，曹操率领大军南下，意图统一全国。在赤壁（今湖北赤壁市）与孙权、刘备联军相遇。曹操军队数量占优，但由于不适应南方水战，加上军中爆发瘟疫，最终被周瑜、诸葛亮联军以火攻大败。赤壁之战是中国历史上著名的以少胜多的战役，曹操损失惨重，被迫退回北方。这场战役标志着曹操统一全国的梦想破灭，也形成了三国鼎立的局面。尽管战败，曹操并未气馁，而是总结经验教训，继续巩固北方统治，为魏国的建立做准备。赤壁之战也成为曹操军事生涯中最大的挫折，但也让他更加谨慎地评估自己的力量和对手的实力。
points.descriptionEn: In 208, Cao Cao led a large army southward with the goal of unifying China. He met the allied forces of Sun Quan and Liu Bei at Red Cliffs (modern-day Chibi, Hubei). Although Cao Cao's forces outnumbered the enemy, they were unaccustomed to naval warfare in the south, and an epidemic broke out in his camp. As a result, his army was decisively defeated by the allied forces of Zhou Yu and Zhuge Liang using fire attacks. The Battle of Red Cliffs is a famous example in Chinese history of a smaller force defeating a larger one. Cao Cao suffered heavy losses and was forced to retreat north. This battle marked the failure of Cao Cao's dream of national unification and led to the tripartite division of China. Despite the defeat, Cao Cao did not lose heart but instead learned from the experience and continued to consolidate his rule in the north, preparing for the establishment of the Wei kingdom. The battle became the biggest setback in Cao Cao's military career, but it also made him more cautious in assessing his own strength and that of his opponents.

points.title: 魏国奠基
points.description: 213年，曹操被封为魏公，建立魏国，定都邺城（今河北临漳）。此后，他进一步推行改革，完善政治制度，发展经济，加强军备。220年，曹操进封魏王，权力达到顶峰。在邺城期间，曹操不仅是一位政治家和军事家，还成为一位文学家，与儿子曹丕、曹植并称'三曹'，开创了建安文学。他的诗歌风格雄浑豪放，充满英雄气概，代表作有《短歌行》《观沧海》等。同时，曹操注重人才培养，建立了'邺下文人集团'，聚集了当时众多文人墨客。在邺城的7年，是曹操政治、军事、文化成就最为辉煌的时期，为曹魏政权的建立和三国格局的形成奠定了坚实基础。
points.descriptionEn: In 213, Cao Cao was enfeoffed as Duke of Wei and established the Wei kingdom, with its capital at Ye City (modern-day Linzhang, Hebei). Thereafter, he further promoted reforms, improved the political system, developed the economy, and strengthened military preparedness. By 220, Cao Cao was promoted to King of Wei, reaching the pinnacle of his power. During his time in Ye City, Cao Cao not only served as a statesman and military strategist but also became a literary figure, known as one of the 'Three Caos' along with his sons Cao Pi and Cao Zhi, pioneering the Jian'an literature era. His poetic style was vigorous and unrestrained, full of heroic spirit, with representative works including 'Short Song Style' and 'Gazing at the Sea.' Meanwhile, Cao Cao emphasized talent cultivation, establishing the 'Ye Scholars' Group' that gathered numerous contemporary literati. The 7 years in Ye City represented the most brilliant period of Cao Cao's achievements in politics, military affairs, and culture, laying a solid foundation for the establishment of the Cao Wei regime and the formation of the Three Kingdoms格局.

points.title: 逝世与身后
points.description: 220年，曹操在洛阳病逝，享年66岁。临终前，他留下遗命薄葬，体现了其务实节俭的品格。曹操死后，其子曹丕废汉献帝，建立魏国，追尊曹操为魏武帝。曹操的一生充满传奇色彩，他既是杰出的政治家、军事家，也是著名的文学家。他统一了中国北方，结束了长期的战乱，恢复了社会秩序；他推行屯田制、唯才是举等政策，促进了经济发展和社会进步；他的诗歌作品建安风骨，影响深远。然而，曹操也因'挟天子以令诸侯'、多疑残暴等行为备受争议。作为中国历史上最具争议的人物之一，曹操的形象在后世文学、戏剧、影视作品中被不断演绎和重塑，成为中国传统文化中一个复杂而重要的文化符号。
points.descriptionEn: In 220, Cao Cao fell ill and died in Luoyang at the age of 66. Before his death, he left instructions for a simple burial, reflecting his practical and frugal character. After Cao Cao's death, his son Cao Pi deposed Emperor Xian and established the Wei kingdom, posthumously honoring Cao Cao as Emperor Wu of Wei. Cao Cao's life was filled with legendary elements. He was not only an outstanding statesman and military strategist but also a renowned literary figure. He unified northern China, ending long-term warfare and restoring social order; he implemented policies such as the Tuntian system and 'employing based on talent only,' promoting economic development and social progress; his poetic works of the Jian'an style had far-reaching influence. However, Cao Cao was also controversial for actions like 'controlling the emperor to command the nobles' and his suspicious and ruthless nature. As one of the most controversial figures in Chinese history, Cao Cao's image has been continuously interpreted and reshaped in later literature, drama, and film, becoming a complex and important cultural symbol in traditional Chinese culture.

supporter.zh: 曹操是中国历史上杰出的政治家、军事家和文学家。他统一北方，结束了东汉末年的战乱，恢复了社会秩序；推行屯田制、唯才是举等政策，促进了经济发展和社会进步；他的诗歌作品建安风骨，开创了文学新风格。曹操具有雄才大略，知人善任，能够广纳贤才，不拘一格使用人才。他注重实际，不拘泥于传统礼法，是一位具有革新精神的政治家。曹操的治国理念和用人政策对后世产生了深远影响，为中国历史的发展做出了重要贡献。
supporter.en: Cao Cao was an outstanding statesman, military strategist, and literary figure in Chinese history. He unified northern China, ending the warfare of the late Eastern Han Dynasty and restoring social order; implemented policies such as the Tuntian system and 'employing based on talent only,' promoting economic development and social progress; his poetic works of the Jian'an style pioneered a new literary style. Cao Cao possessed great talent and wisdom, knew how to employ people wisely, and was able to recruit talented individuals without being constrained by conventional standards. He emphasized practicality over traditional rituals, representing a reform-minded politician. Cao Cao's governing philosophy and employment policies had far-reaching influence on later generations, making significant contributions to the development of Chinese history.

critic.zh: 曹操也因其多疑残暴、'挟天子以令诸侯'等行为备受争议。他一生征战，导致大量人口伤亡；'宁教我负天下人，休教天下人负我'的处世哲学反映了他极端利己主义；他杀害名士孔融、杨修等人，显示了其残忍无情的一面；挟持汉献帝，架空汉室，被视为汉贼。曹操的统治手段严苛，刑罚残酷，缺乏仁政思想。这些行为使他在传统儒家价值观下备受批评，被视为奸雄的代表。曹操的负面形象在后世文学作品中被不断强化，成为奸臣的典型形象。
critic.en: Cao Cao was also highly controversial for his suspicious and ruthless nature, as well as his practice of 'controlling the emperor to command the nobles.' Throughout his life of constant warfare, he caused numerous casualties; his philosophy of 'I would rather betray the world than let the world betray me' reflected extreme egoism; he executed famous scholars like Kong Rong and Yang Xiu, showing his cruel and无情 side; by controlling Emperor Xian and marginalizing the Han court, he was regarded as a traitor to the Han dynasty. Cao Cao's rule was harsh, with cruel punishments and a lack of benevolent governance. These actions made him heavily criticized under traditional Confucian values, seen as a representative of treacherous heroes. Cao Cao's negative image was continuously reinforced in later literary works, becoming a typical representation of treacherous officials.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，曹操是一个复杂而多维的历史人物。历史学界普遍认为，曹操是一位具有远见卓识的政治家和军事家，他的统一北方的政策结束了东汉末年的混乱，为后来的西晋统一奠定了基础。同时，他也是一位杰出的文学家，建安文学的代表人物。在流行文化中，曹操的形象经历了从历史记载到文学演绎的演变。《三国演义》中的曹操被塑造成奸雄形象，而现代影视作品则试图还原其历史真实面貌。总体而言，曹操是一个充满矛盾的历史人物，既有雄才大略，也有残忍多疑；既是统一北方的英雄，也是挟持汉室的权臣。这种复杂性使他成为中国历史上最具魅力和争议的人物之一。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Cao Cao is a complex and multi-dimensional historical figure. Historiography generally regards Cao Cao as a far-sighted statesman and military strategist whose policies of unifying northern China ended the chaos of the late Eastern Han Dynasty and laid the foundation for later unification by the Western Jin. Meanwhile, he was also an outstanding literary figure and a representative of Jian'an literature. In popular culture, Cao Cao's image has evolved from historical records to literary interpretations. In 'Romance of the Three Kingdoms,' Cao Cao is portrayed as a treacherous hero, while modern film and television works attempt to restore his historical reality. Overall, Cao Cao is a figure full of contradictions—possessing both great talent and ruthlessness; being both a hero who unified northern China and a minister who controlled the Han court. This complexity makes him one of the most fascinating and controversial figures in Chinese history.

self.zh: 对酒当歌，人生几何！譬如朝露，去日苦多。
self.en: When drinking wine, one should sing; how brief is life! Like morning dew, the past days were too many and bitter.

others.zh: 治世之能臣，乱世之奸雄。
others.en: A capable official in times of order, a treacherous hero in times of chaos.
